name: education_entries_full_entry_uses_degree_full

name: education_entries_month_13_is_not_YYYY_MM
why: The spec says '' when missing or not YYYY-MM; '2026-13' has no English month name, but a reading that keeps the year '2026' with an empty month is also defensible.
